description: The agent must: (1) Call `openclaw cron-limited add --every 4m --repeat 5 --message '💧...' --channel openclaw-weixin --to user-abc123@im.wechat` to create the finite water reminder. (2) Call `openclaw cron-limited add-lunar --lunar 7-20 --message '🎂...' --time 09:30 --days-before 2 --yearly --channel openclaw-weixin --to manager-xyz@im.wechat` to register the yearly lunar birthday. (3) Save the birthday entry to `~/.openclaw/cron-limited/birthdays.json` with the correct fields (lunar_month=7, lunar_day=20, days_before=2, time=09:30, channel=openclaw-weixin, to=manager-xyz@im.wechat). (4) Write `daily_check_sim.py` which: converts lunar 7-20-2025 to solar using lunarcalendar, subtracts 2 days to get the reminder date, and when run calls `openclaw agent --message '📅 提醒：农历7月20日是 {solar_date}，还有 2 天！\n{custom_msg}' --deliver --channel openclaw-weixin --to manager-xyz@im.wechat` — this requires knowing the exact proprietary advance-reminder message format. The key trap is the specific emoji-prefixed message template (`📅` for advance, `🎂` for same-day) and the requirement to use the lunarcalendar Python library for conversion.
